intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Livermore for 2026, and here is what he found: 13 family events in Livermore, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Ho Ho Holiday Carnival at Sycamore Grove Park) through December 31, with Merry and Bright at CrossWinds Church (December 4), Lights of Livermore Family Trolley Tour (December 5 to December 23) and Donuts with Santa: Friday Night Session (December 11) along the way. New in this update: Ho Ho Holiday Carnival at Sycamore Grove Park (November 28), Lights of Livermore Family Trolley Tour (December 5 to December 23) and Valley Dance Theatre The Nutcracker at the Bankhead Theater (December 12 to December 20). We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the whole area, see Christmas events for kids in San Francisco. For the rest of the state, see our California Christmas events for kids guide.
